privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Below we explain how we process personal data of visitors of the SiteConcept website, including the data submitted via the contact form and information stored through cookies.

dataProtection.heading: Data protection
dataProtection.text: We process personal data to respond to inquiries and support users. The data controller is SiteConcept. We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.text: The website may use cookies and similar technologies (for example local storage of preferences) to run the site and remember your consent. This data is not used to identify users in a way that violates privacy.

contactForm.heading: Contact form
contactForm.text: Submitting the contact form means you provide your email address and message content. We process this data to respond to your request. You can contact us at any time regarding your data.
